_meta.description: Whole-string-literal renames at a major version: core form/view/action path strings that were renamed, safe to auto-rewrite by matching a PHP string literal's ENTIRE value exactly (never a substring, never inside a comment/identifier). Consumed by the data-driven rules under ElggMigrate\Rules\* via Rules\Shared\DataDrivenStringLiteralRenames (an AST String_-node visitor). Per-major.
_meta.why_all_representations: A core form has three string forms in plugin code: the short form/action NAME passed to elgg_view_form()/elgg_register_action()/elgg_generate_action_url() ('blog/save'), the full VIEW path ('forms/blog/save'), and the full ACTION path ('action/blog/save'). All three are listed so an exact whole-string match catches real usage.
_meta.excluded: View OVERRIDE files (views/default/forms/blog/save.php) are file renames, not string literals — those stay LLM-guided (manifest 007). Renames with substring/prefix overlap risk (Elgg 7 members routes collection:user:user → collection:user:user:all) are NOT here; a whole-string match is safe but the members case is kept LLM (rule 012) pending review.
